  PROBLEM: The exception lets a step through whenever its body has any `-z` or `-n` test on WORKSPACE_PATH. It ignores what the guard does when it fires and where the guard sits. The inlined checkout script's guard at line 186 (`if [ -z "${WORKSPACE_PATH:-}" ] || [ ! -d "${WORKSPACE_PATH}" ]; then`, `exit 1` at line 188) matches the regex.

Suggested fix: refuse the exception when the body contains `CHECKOUT_STEP_SCRIPT` or "Review workspace is unavailable", and optionally require the guard to come before the first use. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
